versions.changelog:
Initial release of motion-takeover-f100k: fullscreen motion graphics "takeovers" for YouTube (16:9) videos with face, inspired by "Claude Routines".

- Plans and renders faceless motion graphics takeovers (SVG/AI mockups, etc.) that fully cover the screen at key moments, then return to face mode.
- Users send the .srt of the pre-cut video (16:9 with face) and a reference frame; the system maps out two tracks (takeovers + overlays) and outputs a "montage sheet" with the exact timings for editing.
- Takeovers rendered as 1920x1080 PNG; optional animation with Higgsfield for smooth, non-distorted text/video.
- All outputs (board, rendered PNG/MP4, montage sheet) delivered for use in external editors; no video composition done in-skill.
- Only for YouTube horizontal (16:9) — not for reels/shorts or simple overlays.
- Runs inside OpenClaw agent via Telegram; strictly enforces audio sync and non-des
